title: Corrective replay of logos D6 A319/*904 source-layer conflict

external_prior_art.claim: D6: transliteration layer contains *904 in 3/3 label-bearing documents whose parsedInscription layer contains U+1066B LINEAR A SIGN A319.
external_prior_art.matching_semantics: A document is label-bearing when ANY transliteratedWords item CONTAINS the substring '*904'; exact whole-token equality is not required.

identified_JANUS_replay_defect.why_old_predicate_fails: HTZd155 stores the label inside the compound source word NA-MA-MA-TI-TI-*904, so exact equality returns zero despite the source label being present.

required_tests: label occurrence count by substring-bearing word

decision_rule.CONFIRMED_EXTERNAL_REPLAY_CORRECTED: label-bearing set equals glyph-bearing set and all three seeded documents co-present under upstream substring semantics.
decision_rule.PARTIAL: nonempty overlap but sets differ or fewer than 3 seeded cases co-present.
